pub type Raw
pub enum DecisionOutcome
  Permitted
  Denied
  NotGranted
  UnknownAction
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 7]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum PolicyPageOutcome
  Page
  Gap
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum PolicyEditOutcome
  Applied
  Conflict
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum RuleReadOutcome
  Found
  Expired
  Unknown
  Invalid
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 6]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum ActionEditOutcome
  Applied
  Conflict
  Unknown
  Invalid
  Exhausted
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 7]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub mod service_error_code
  pub const HANDLER_ERROR: &str
  pub const INVALID_RESULT: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_VERSION: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_SERVICE: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_METHOD: &str
  pub const WRONG_MODE: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 6]
pub const OPERATIONS: [&str; 9]
pub const KNOWN_RIGHTS: [&str; 1]
pub const REFUSAL_CODES: [&str; 15]
pub const RESOURCE_ACTIONS: [&str; 11]
pub struct Request
  op: String
  name: String
  rights: Vec<String>
  secret: String
  token: String
  right: String
  why: String
  app: String
  admin: String
pub struct AppMetadata
  id: String
  name: String
  rights: Vec<String>
  registered: String
pub struct HoldMetadata
  app: String
  name: String
  right: String
  why: String
  since: String
pub struct ResponseMetadata
  code: String
  error: String
  secret: String
  token: String
  expires: String
  app: Option<AppMetadata>
  right: String
  apps: Vec<AppMetadata>
  holds: Vec<HoldMetadata>
pub struct Subject
  account: String
  program: String
pub struct Decision
  outcome: DecisionOutcome
  policy_revision: String
pub struct PolicyRule
  subject: Subject
  action: String
  resource: String
  permit: bool
pub struct PolicyPage
  outcome: PolicyPageOutcome
  revision: String
  catalog: Vec<String>
  rules: Vec<PolicyRule>
  next: String
  complete: bool
pub struct PolicyEdit
  outcome: PolicyEditOutcome
  revision: String
  current: Option<PolicyRule>
pub struct RuleRecord
  rule: PolicyRule
  set_by: Subject
  set_at: String
  why: String
  expires: String
pub struct RuleRead
  outcome: RuleReadOutcome
  revision: String
  record: Option<RuleRecord>
pub struct CatalogEntry
  action: String
  registered_by: Subject
  registered_at: String
pub struct ActionEdit
  outcome: ActionEditOutcome
  revision: String
  current: Option<CatalogEntry>
pub fn encode(v: &Request) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Request, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: String
  message: String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait Authorization
  type Error
  fn decide(&self, action: String, resource: String) -> Result<Decision, Self::Error>
  fn decide_for(&self, subject: Subject, action: String, resource: String) -> Result<Decision, Self::Error>
pub struct AuthorizationClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait AuthorizationOperator
  type Error
  fn list_policy(&self, cursor: String, limit: i64) -> Result<PolicyPage, Self::Error>
  fn set_rule(&self, expected_revision: String, rule: PolicyRule) -> Result<PolicyEdit, Self::Error>
  fn revoke_rule(&self, expected_revision: String, subject: Subject, action: String, resource: String) -> Result<PolicyEdit, Self::Error>
  fn set_rule_for(&self, expected_revision: String, rule: PolicyRule, ttl_ms: i64, why: String) -> Result<PolicyEdit, Self::Error>
  fn read_rule(&self, subject: Subject, action: String, resource: String) -> Result<RuleRead, Self::Error>
  fn register_action(&self, expected_revision: String, action: String) -> Result<ActionEdit, Self::Error>
  fn retire_action(&self, expected_revision: String, action: String) -> Result<ActionEdit, Self::Error>
pub struct AuthorizationOperatorClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
